GUARDIAN.title: Guardian
GUARDIAN.description: A stalwart defender who excels at blocking and counterattacking.
GUARDIAN.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gold]The wind remembers every defense. I will not yield.[/gold][/sine]
GUARDIAN.eventDeathPrevention: The wall still stands. So must I.
GUARDIAN.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to mend shield and armor for the next defense...[/sine]
IRONEYE.title: Ironeye
IRONEYE.description: A watchful archer who reads the field with an eagle eye and looses each arrow at the moment a weakness appears.
IRONEYE.aromaPrinciple: [sine][green]Keep the distance. Find the opening. End it with one arrow.[/green][/sine]
IRONEYE.eventDeathPrevention: The quarry lies ahead. I cannot fall here.
REVENANT.title: Revenant
REVENANT.description: A spirit caller who fights beside family and the dead.
REVENANT.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]In life or death, we meet again.[/purple][/sine]
REVENANT.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to prepare the family for the road ahead.[/sine]
